evidence.note: United Press sentencing report, Medford Mail Tribune Friday August 8,1952 page1, explicitly says the fourteen Smith Act defendants received five years and $10,000 each on Thursday, August7. This is the conspiracy sentence, distinct from the August5 verdict and the August8 Yates contempt sentence.
